name: Flax Typhoon (Ethereal Panda, Red Juliett)
description:
2026-10-08 | Critical Infrastructure Targeting via Botnets and Edge Exploitation
Target: Critical infrastructure, critical manufacturing, IT, government facilities, and OT systems across Southeast Asia, North America, and Africa.
Vector: Exploitation of edge devices and known vulnerabilities (including CVE-2019-11510, CVE-2021-22205, CVE-2023-22894), automated botnets enabled by Integrity Technology Group, password spraying against Microsoft Exchange, and living-off-the-land (LOTL) tools.
Impact: Stealthy long-term persistence in critical and operational technology (OT) environments, credential and email theft, and pre-positioning for future disruptive activity.
